method: Every audio sample was generated by gemini-3.1-flash-tts and judged by gemini-3.5-flash (given the audio as multimodal input) on a strict 0-10 rubric: does this sound like a calm, professional audiobook narrator PLAINLY READING the text, as opposed to an actor PERFORMING it. Scores <=3 required an audible vocal burst (laugh/gasp/sigh) or clear acting. Because gemini-3.1-flash-tts runs at temperature=1 by default, each (prompt, voice) combination was sampled multiple independent times — a single sample is not reliable evidence, since the SAME prompt+voice can swing from a perfect reading to an over-acted one on different draws.
narration_text_under_test: The kitchen smelled of toast and burnt coffee. Alice laughed despite herself, surprised by how much she had missed this ordinary morning chaos. Bob leaned against the counter, watching her with the quiet, settled look of someone who already knew how the rest of the day would go.

phase3_temperature_sweep.description: Tested whether lowering TTS temperature below the default 1.0 improves reliability, for the two leading voices with the winning prompt. Small sample sizes on some cells (some batches hit API rate-limit timeouts under this session's heavy concurrent load).
phase3_temperature_sweep.finding: No evidence that lowering temperature helps; Iapetus scored WORSE at 0.3 (67%) and 0.6 (50%) than at the default 1.0 (87.5%). Temperature left at the default.

final_recommendation.prompt_text: Speak in a plain, measured, matter-of-fact narrator tone — calm and pleasant but emotionally reserved, the way a documentary narrator or news reader speaks. No dramatization, no character acting, no exaggerated emotional inflection, no vocal bursts of any kind (no gasping, laughing, sighing aloud). Even, steady pacing throughout.
final_recommendation.caveat: Not 100% reliable — roughly 1 in 8 draws with the winning combination still produced an audible vocal burst or over-acted delivery. This appears to be inherent TTS model randomness at temperature=1, not fixable by prompt/voice/temperature choice alone. The prior default (Algenib + old prompt) scored 0% (0/3) by comparison.
